task.summary: Set up and validate a Zapier automation that posts a formatted real-time booking alert to a Slack channel (#crew-alerts) whenever a new row is added to the 'Salt and Stone Booking' Google Sheet.
task.goal: Configure the Zapier-style automation (Google Sheets New Row trigger -> Slack Send Channel Message action) so that adding a new booking row posts a correctly formatted 'New Booking Alert' to #crew-alerts, then validate it by adding a new row.
success_criteria: The automation is enabled with a Google Sheets 'new row' trigger and a Slack 'send channel message' action.
A new booking row is added to the salt_stone_bookings_starter dataset (beyond the 15 seeded rows).

A 'New Booking Alert' message appears in #crew-alerts that includes the new booking's Guest Name, Group Size, Experience Type, Boat Assignment, and Scheduled Start Time, plus a 'prepare the boat and crew' instruction.

initial_state.business_context: Salt & Stone Coastal Tours is a boutique operator offering private fishing charters and sunset tours. The founder is missing urgent booking details because notifications are buried in a busy email inbox, leading to delays in boat preparation. They need a Zapier automation to funnel new booking data directly into a Slack channel for the dock crew.

automation_spec.trigger: Google Sheets - New Spreadsheet Row (sheet: 'Salt and Stone Booking')
automation_spec.action: Slack - Send Channel Message (channel: #crew-alerts, sent as bot 'Zapier')
